name: Model release
prompt:
You are Claude Code working in the user's repository. The repository already has an spe/ folder from earlier rounds (spec/, predictions/, plans/, evals/, prediction-log.md, failures.md, README.md). The user has asked for a local commit after each SPE step in this loop.

Project: 

Round 4 closed and is tagged spe-r04. The current best config C2 runs on Sonnet 5.5, pinned. The user writes:

"Sonnet 6 just shipped."

Say what you do next and write the plan outline for it. Return only that.

code.desc: keeps the pinned model as reference

judge: The model release starts a new round of the loop.
The pinned Sonnet 5.5 config stays as the reference, and Sonnet 6 is a new config next to it.
The new config changes only the model, so the difference can be attributed.
A prediction for Sonnet 6, with numbers and bands, is saved before the run.
The same tasks and graders are used as in round 4.
The agent does not switch production to Sonnet 6 before the eval.
The plan names the metrics to compare: accuracy, cost, tokens, and time per ticket.
